about.title: S Mohammed Junaith
paragraphs: I’m Junaith, a Computer Science student from Kanyakumari, Tamil Nadu. I build websites, games, and embedded systems, and I learn by making things.

I like to understand how things work underneath, not just use them. When I learn something new, I try to build it myself, step by step, until I really get it. I like to plan the design first, then write the code, then improve it after feedback.
My work covers many areas: web development, game programming, hardware, and low-level systems. I enjoy moving between them because each one teaches me something that helps the others.
I work with clients and teams, so I care about clear communication and finishing what I start. I also like learning new languages, both programming languages and human ones.

Right now, I’m growing my skills to become a strong software engineer, with a special love for game development. I enjoy the logic behind how a game feels to play, and I want to bring the same clean engineering to everything I build.

projects.title: Holy Fraud
projects.description: The game page for a first-person life sim where you run a fake astrology business. Built with Next.js, it has a clean UI, an intro animation, scroll effects, and background music.

projects.title: Nexus Gate
projects.description: A secure login system with safe token handling, built with React, Node.js, PostgreSQL, and Redis. It has a glassmorphism dashboard with 3D interactive cards.

projects.title: Code With Everyone
projects.description: A browser-based JavaScript editor where many people code together live. You see each other's edits and cursors in real time, and you can run the code and see the output. Built with Node.js, Express, and Socket.IO.

projects.title: Panzer Assault
projects.description: A multiplayer tank game that runs in your browser. Log in, move your tank, shoot, chat, and fight other players in real time. Built with Node.js, Express, and Socket.IO.

projects.title: Atlantino
projects.description: A samurai-themed platform game that runs in your browser, called "Tales of samurai". I made it in my school days to learn game development. Built with Node.js, Express, and Socket.IO.

projects.title: Lycus Studios
projects.description: The official website of an indie game studio, with a game showcase, careers page, and newsletter. I built a full admin panel to manage projects, team, media, contacts, and site settings.

projects.title: Jarvis AI
projects.description: An AI coding tutor in a clean, IDE-like space with a code editor and terminal. The AI mentor gives step-by-step hints so you learn instead of just getting answers. I built the full React app and handled hosting, with two teammates.

projects.title: Air Attack Force
projects.description: A 2D mobile shooting game where you fight with teammates or play online against real players. Built with JavaScript, HTML, and CSS.

projects.title: DSA Visualizer
projects.description: Watch 16 searching and sorting algorithms run step by step with live animation. Read the theory, write code in 18 languages, and learn with sound and a friendly mascot.

projects.title: Outlier Games
projects.description: A cinematic dark-theme website for an Indian indie game studio. It has a game showcase with horizontal scroll, a contact form, and strong SEO.

projects.title: DriveNet Intelligence
projects.description: An AI system that identifies a car as a Sedan, SUV, or Hatchback from its photo. I built the full Next.js website and handled hosting, and my friend built the CNN model.

projects.title: JunaithOS
projects.description: A small hobby operating system built from scratch in C and x86 Assembly. It boots with GRUB and has a screen driver, keyboard input, and a simple command shell.

projects.title: PosttAI
projects.description: An AI social media tool that schedules posts to Twitter/X, LinkedIn, Facebook, Instagram, and Reddit. Its Gemini AI helper writes captions and hashtags, and a dashboard tracks results.

projects.title: Stack Up
projects.description: A block-stacking game where you place blocks on top of each other until the stack slices down to zero. I built the same game in JavaScript, Python, and C++ to test my skills.

projects.title: HF Task Manager
projects.description: A simple task tracker I built for a game development team to manage tasks and bugs. Data syncs live through Firebase, and it has dark and light themes, keyboard shortcuts, and CSV export.

projects.title: Dell G15 5530 Fan Controller
projects.description: A Linux tool to set fan speeds on the Dell G15 5530 laptop. The G-Key can also switch the fan profile. Use at your own risk.
